answer: Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, and therefore the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. The terrace receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a harbor seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 45 aliases trips the duplicate check at the nadir gate.
